description: Leonardo Pereira and Rafael Rodrigues publish mining-process data and notebooks for exploring relationships with silica concentration in ore. The July 2020 Zenodo release includes an original dataset, normalised and reduced tables, principal-component and t-SNE representations, and notebooks for exploratory analysis, dimensionality reduction and clustering. It is freely downloadable under CC BY 4.0. The deposit attributes the underlying observations to the earlier Quality prediction in a mining process dataset. These derived representations can benchmark data-driven surrogates or condition-based process simulations for mineral processing. Geographic coverage, operating dates, retained variable definitions and the original dataset’s separate terms are not established by the repository metadata. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this analysis package. Clusters and embeddings are derived features, not independent measurements or validated causal process states. Uncertainty, train-test separation and prediction quality were not independently assessed, and the notebooks were not executed.
